Highlights:
## G Series｜M.2 2280 PCIe ® 4.0 NVMe™ Gaming SSD

8TB / 4TB / 2TB / 1TB 

## Elite gaming M.2

Ultra-fast speeds and power with the latest technology of PCIe® 4.0 G Series NVMe™ SSD builds the best gaming rig – enhances your play to victory.

## Boost your play

#### Max 7300 MB/s Read

Up to 7,300 MB/s read speed 1 reaching the limits of PCIe ® 4.0 data bandwidth, shortens load times when fast travel and entering dungeons in huge maps of MMORPGs and open-world/sandbox games.

#### Max 1000K IOPS Read

Random read performance of up to 1,000,000 IOPS 1 reduces gameplay annoyances such as lags and slowdowns by delivering powerful processing performance for heavy graphics rendering, allowing players to experience a smooth and immersive gaming tempo.

#### Max 2GB DDR4 DRAM

Up to 2 GB 1 of DDR4 DRAM boosts performance by storing fast-accessing data in DRAM instead of NAND. It also reduces the number of direct accesses to NAND, which consequently extends the life of the SSD.

## power and endurance

G Series NVMe™ SSD is rated the drive with an endurance of up to 10,000 TBW (for NE1N8TB) 2 and 1,600,000 hours of MTBF 3. The synergy of flash management technology improves both performance and memory life.

...

## Compatibility

・Compatible with computers equipped with an M.2 (M Key) port supporting the M.2 2280 form factor. ・Supports PCIe 4.0 standard and NVMe protocol.

...

The NEM-PA and G series are M.2 2280 SSD equipped with a PCIe® 4.0 / NVMe 1.4 controller and a 3D TLC NAND. The drive achieves sequential read up to 7,300 MB/s [1], sequential write up to 6,900 MB/s [1], and random read/write up to 1,000 K IOPS [1] (in a PC environment). The NEM-PA series comes with a heatsink for heat dissipation. Both series deliver high-speed loading and smooth gaming experience.
